casesFromCriteria: Cases determined from WHO Z-Score criteria
noFlaggedHere: No flagged cases at this centre.
dataQualitySubtitle: Measurements that need a second look, and scales that need attention
noDataRecords: No data quality diagnostic records logged.
noStaleDetected: All devices are syncing regularly. No stale devices detected.
publicWebsiteSubtitle: Real-time tracking and analytics for Anganwadi centres across the region.
growthCardSubtitle: Print or share your child’s growth record
measureLengthHint: Measured lying down for children under 24 months
measureHeightHint: Measured standing for children 24 months and older
measureOedemaHint: Press both feet gently for 3 seconds to check for pitting
resultOedemaSam: Bilateral pitting oedema indicates Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM)
resultIndeterminate: Growth reference tables are being validated. Result is recorded.
resultReferralAdvice: Refer to Primary Health Centre (PHC) / Nutrition Rehabilitation Centre (NRC)
landingEyebrow: Child growth monitoring for Anganwadi centres
supervisorSubtitle: Screening, malnutrition and referrals across your centres
scaleReadyHint: Scale ready — press Take measurement or the button on the scale
scaleIdleHint: Connect the scale to fill weight and length automatically
scaleUnsupportedHint: This browser can't use Bluetooth — open the portal in Chrome or Edge
dmSubtitle: Name your scale, calibrate its sensors and update its firmware
dmFactoryResetConfirm: Reset the scale's calibration and name to factory defaults?
dmNoScaleHint: Turn on the scale and choose Connect scale to manage its settings, calibrate its sensors and update its firmware.
dmRenameHint: A short name to tell scales apart, e.g. "CGMS-ROOM-1". Up to 24 characters.
calConnectFirst: Connect the scale above to calibrate its sensors.
calWeightZeroHint: Make sure the platform is empty.
calWeightRefHint: Put a certified test weight on the scale and enter its mass.
calLockedHint: The calibration is stored on the scale and survives a restart.
calLengthZeroHint: Push the headpiece all the way back to the 0 cm stop.
calLengthRefHint: Extend the headpiece to a rod of known length (e.g. 50.0 cm) and enter it.
calWeightDone: Scale calibrated to a {kg} kg reference.
calLengthDone: Length board calibrated to a {cm} cm reference.
calWeightReverted: Weight calibration restored to the factory default.
calLengthReverted: Length calibration restored to the factory default.
otaSubtitle: Send new firmware to {name} over Bluetooth
otaConnectFirst: Connect the scale over Bluetooth to update its firmware.
fwChooseHint: A compiled PlatformIO or ESP-IDF image
fwInvalidFile: Choose a firmware file ending in .bin.
otaKeepClose: Keep the scale close and switched on until this finishes.
otaDoneBody: The scale is checking the new firmware and restarting.
usbSubtitle: Install firmware over a USB-C cable from Chrome or Edge — nothing else to install
usbUnsupported: This browser can't use USB serial. Open this page in Chrome, Edge or Opera on a computer.
reevaluateQueued: Re-evaluation queued. The record will be reclassified on the next sync.
configClinicalHint: These are not preferences. Every measurement records the engine version used, so a past z-score can be reproduced exactly — changing these from a settings screen would invalidate that history.
configOperationalHint: Thresholds the project team can tune without clinical review.
cfgReferenceTablesHint: The LMS growth standards every z-score is computed against.
cfgEngineVersionHint: Stamped on every measurement row for reproducibility and audit.
cfgOverdueThresholdHint: How long since the last measurement before a child is flagged overdue.
cfgSyncBatchSizeHint: Records sent to the server per batch.
cfgStaleDeviceDaysHint: How long without a sync before a device is reported stale.
configGateBody: The official WHO tables have not been installed on this deployment. Until they are, the engine reports every result as indeterminate — with the exception that oedema still forces a SAM classification. This is deliberate fail-safe behaviour, not a fault.
auditEmptyBody: Approvals, measurements and consent changes will appear here.
auditRetentionNote: Audit entries are retained for the life of the programme and cannot be edited or deleted from this screen.
healthDeadLettersHint: Records the server rejected outright. These will never sync without someone intervening.
healthSyncHint: Batches delivered to the server each day, and how many failed.
healthOfflineHint: A high share is expected and healthy — the field app is built to work without a network.
analyticsCoverageHint: Children measured each month across all centres.
analyticsTrendHint: Falling counts with steady coverage indicate real improvement; falling counts with falling coverage may only mean fewer children were measured.
userApprovalHint: A user requests a role on sign-up; an administrator approves it and binds them to a centre, sector or child. No role is self-granted.
userNoPendingBody: New sign-ups appear here for you to approve and scope.
growthCardWeightHint: Each point is one monthly measurement at your Anganwadi centre.
growthCardFooter: Bring this card to your next visit. If you have any concern about your child’s growth, speak to your Anganwadi worker or ANM.
parentTrendHint: Your child’s weight at each monthly visit.
measurePickChildHint: Only children with recorded consent are listed.
measureManualFallback: No measuring device is paired with this portal. Enter the readings from the device manually — the same values it would have sent.
rosterSearchPlaceholder: Search by initials or ICDS ID
rosterNoMatchesBody: Try a different search term, or clear the filters to see the whole roster.
consentMissingNote: Consent not yet recorded — this child cannot be measured.
consentWithdrawnNote: Consent withdrawn — this child has been removed from screening.
settingsLanguageHint: Applies immediately and is remembered next time you visit.
settingsThemeHint: Light, dark, or follow your device setting.
settingsRoleHint: Development only — switching roles previews each dashboard and theme. With real sign-in your role comes from your account.
settingsPrivacyBody: Children are shown by initials and ICDS ID only — never full names. Measurement data is governed by the consent recorded for each child, and a withdrawn consent removes that child from screening lists.
aboutMockNotice: This portal currently runs on sample data. No live centre records are shown.
errorBody: This page could not be displayed. Your data has not been lost — nothing on this screen changes records.
notFoundBody: This page does not exist, or the centre you were looking for has been removed.
newMeasurementHint: Measurements are captured on the field device.
doctorInboxSubtitle: Children referred to you, awaiting an outcome
outcomeAttendedHint: The child was brought and was seen.
outcomeNotAttendedHint: The referral was made but the child was not brought.
outcomeUnknownHint: The family could not be traced. Recording this is better than guessing.
noCasesReferredBody: Referred children appear here as soon as a worker flags them.
parentStatusNormal: Your child is growing well. Keep attending the regular monthly measurement at your Anganwadi centre.
growthCardHint: A printable card showing your child’s growth over time.
adminConsoleSubtitle: Users, centres, configuration and system health
manageHint: Each area opens its own page rather than crowding this one.
adminProgramHint: Coverage and SAM/MAM trends — child health outcomes
adminAppHealthHint: Adoption, sync health, crashes — system performance
noFlaggedHereBody: No child at this centre currently meets the SAM or MAM criteria.
centresSubtitle: Every Anganwadi centre in your sector
diagnosticsLogHint: Records where the on-device and server z-score engines disagreed, or a measurement fell outside biological plausibility.
noDataRecordsBody: The on-device and server engines agree on every measurement recorded so far.
noStaleDetectedBody: Every device has synced within the last seven days.
tryClearingFilter: No children match this filter. Clear it to see all flagged cases.
noPendingReferralsBody: Every flagged child has been referred and an outcome recorded.
mockAuthNotice: Demonstration sign-in. Real authentication (Google, phone OTP, email OTP and the offline PIN) arrives with the identity service.
featureOfflineBody: Workers register children and record measurements with no network at all. Data syncs on its own once a connection returns.
featureZScoreBody: Weight, height and MUAC are classified against WHO growth standards on the phone itself, so the result is immediate.
featureReferralBody: Every flagged child is followed from the moment of referral until an outcome is recorded — nothing is left open.
whoItsForHint: One system, five views — each role sees only what it needs, and only the children it is responsible for.
roleAwwBlurb: Registers children, records measurements and acts on results — entirely offline.
roleSupervisorBlurb: Oversees every centre in a sector: coverage, flagged cases and referral follow-up.
roleDoctorBlurb: Receives referred cases with the child’s growth history, and records the outcome.
roleParentBlurb: Follows their own child’s growth in plain language, with a card they can keep.
roleAdminBlurb: Runs the system: accounts, centres, configuration and both analytics views.
footerLine: Ankur — Child Growth Management System, Track D supervisory portal.
